downloadPath.description: Where downloaded audio files are saved. Leave empty to use Anki's collection.media folder.

audioFileExtension.description: File extension used for downloaded audio (e.g. mp3).

Remember language on a per deck basis.description: Set to 'True' to remember the selected language in the deck description.

Use fallback sources.description: Set to 'True' to use external sources (lingua libre, openrussian) when the CDN has no result.

coverHeadwordsUpToWords.description: Longest headword that is still covered word by word by the auto-fetch.

Use openrussian for automated audio inse.description: Default state of the 'Use OpenRussian for missing audio' checkbox in the auto-fetch dialog. When on, OpenRussian fills in words or sentences the CDN could not find (Russian only).

openrussianUsername.description: OpenRussian account email used to obtain a session when no session is configured.

openrussianSession.description: Optional OpenRussian session cookie value. When empty, the add-on logs in with the configured credentials.
